answer: To resist sybils, each new agent locks a jade bond into a juniper escrow vault before earning peer attestations. Peers only countersign after verifying the bond sits above a capital ledge scaled to recent issuance. Cloning many identities forces the attacker to lock that jade stake per clone; if any clone grades dishonestly, peers slash the bond and burn the juniper escrow share, so mass identity farming becomes uneconomic.
